notes.title: Build 4706 (8th Sept 2021) - revision 72103
notes.content:
[u]New Features[/u]

• Looking For Group has now been added. This new feature will notify you when there are public games running if you are not in an online game yourself. This is enabled for all users by default in the main menu and can turned on/off via a button on the console in the main menu

• The console has been revamped. We've reorganised the console and added some quality-of-life improvements to make it easier to find the game modes that you're looking for

• New ranks have been added to player tags

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

• Fixed a bug where it was not possible to move sliders without grabbing them

• Fixed a bug where debris didn't launch in the intended direction

• Fixed a bug where anomalies would instantly fail if replayed without starting a fresh game

• Fixed a bug where it was possible to interact with the pause menu when the report menu was open

• Fixed a bug where it was possible to get someone else’s haptics in your controller

notes.title: Pre-Birthday Patch - #4116
notes.content:
Greetings cadets! We've just released a patch for Spaceteam VR addressing a number of bugs, quality of life issues along with general performances fixes. This is ahead of our 1 year anniversary event which will be taking place over the weekend of May 21st - 24th

General
•	Improvements to the Vive Controller mappings
•	Improved the positioning of hands for index controllers
•	General improvements made to positioning of hands when grabbing objects
•	Improvements to the grip accuracy for dials
•	Improved accuracy for collisions of Robot hands
•	Improved positioning of objects grabbed by Robot hands
•	Chair model added for users using seated mode
•	Increased the threshold needed to be reached by all players for the pump anomaly

Bug Fixes
•	Fixed a crash for the Vive Pro with NVidia driver version 461.40
•	Fixed a bug where settings were set as save before the save occurred
•	Fixed a bug where you could spawn outside of the lobby
•	Fixed a bug where avatar wrists would either appear disconnected or broken
•	Fixed a bug where Robots would either read instructions wrong or not at all with more complex instructions
•	Fixed a bug where a Robot’s speech could stop all together
•	Fixed a bug where a Robot would continue reading redundant instructions, even if a new instruction is ready
•	Fixed a bug where a Robot would not finish its current instruction on the end of a sector
•	Fixed a bug where the height calibration screen was grabbable
•	Fixed a bug with the report menu, where it’s buttons where not usable
•	Fixed a bug where incorrect LOD groups were being used for some avatar textures
•	Fixed a bug with the pump anomaly where the game would not progress, even if completed
•	Fixed a server crash caused by internal checks in the game’s logic

notes.title: UPDATE TIME - 2918
notes.content:
[h1]2918 (6th August 2020) [/h1]
Please update your game version otherwise online functions will not work

[b]General[/b]

•	New GOLDEN player tags for ThursdayTeamTime winners.
•	Improved avatar performance, so your virtual you should express a more true version of your awesome actions.
•	New male avatar body!
•	News no longer displays over your panel if there is unread news. Instead, the news icon shows when there is unread news, so you can read it when you like.
•	Fixed a bug where repair robots could T-pose when desperately trying to Dab. Robots need to Dab.
•	Control labels can span two lines now, making for clearer panels.
•	Fixed the Discord URL
•	Fixed some bugs stopping the Robot faces showing their full glory across the game. Poor Robots.
•	Fixed some issues with the notifications not showing correctly.
•	Fixed an issue where the mini avatar could T-pose… whether they wanted tea or not.


[b]Gameplay / Difficulty [/b]

•	Disco and Freeze anomalies now correctly give position and negative results… if you fail, you take some damage on your panel.
•	Damage from power surges is spread around the panel better… rather than just trashing the whole panel.
•	Freeze is no longer allowed at the same time as Slime, or Oil Leak… you had to move, so it could be a little… harsh.


[b]Practice[/b]
•	Fixed a bug where the AI Robots weren’t always the right Robots.


[b]Multiplayer[/b]

•	Fixed a bug where some players avatars would be the wrong height depending on when they joined the server.
•	The nasty scratched record sound no longer plays incorrectly at the end of sectors…. Only when you fail to meet the grade for Disco.

[b]Tutorial[/b]
•	Fixed a bug with the repair side of the tutorial.

notes.title: We have BLAST OFF!
notes.content:
We launched the game last Thursday to a very warm reaction from players and reviewers alike...

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EYnYjZfX0AMbe-7?format=png&name=900x900[/img]

[h2]"Spaceteam VR will break friendships, ruin your vocal cords and raise your blood pressure. That is to say, it’s quite a delight."[/h2]

[url=https://uploadvr.com/spaceteam-vr-review/]Jamie Feltham, Upload VR[/url]

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
We're putting an update up TODAY in order to address some issues that become obvious on launch and some things we'd been work on since submitting the launch build for review

[h2]Ship teleporter improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] When starting a game or playing again (positions relative to the console have been improved)
[*] Seated mode players are now teleported correctly!
[*] Fixed issues when playing again if other players had left the game
[/list]

[h2]Interactions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed some collisions on the control panel and menu causing issues with the players VR position (it was possible to push yourself away from where you should be stood!)
[*] Fixed issue with grip seeming to act like a toggle when you have poor network conditions
[/list]

[h2]Ship interface upgrade[/h2]
[list]
[*] Anomaly instruction text will always fit on the players monitor 
[*] Height calibration system tweaks
[*] The settings and in-game menu now have options for the Sound and Voices volume levels!
[*] Leaderboard titles now appear immediately to allow for quicker navigation and you can toggle to view your friends as well as global leaderboards!
[*] Fixed the ‘Highest Sector’ leaderboards reporting one less than they should be!
[*] Oil and Goop fixes
[*] The Comet Innovations™ Repair-Hammer™ has had an upgrade to how reliably it fixes your console
[/list]

[h2]STEAM[/h2]
[list]
[*] STEAM Rich Presence is now set correctly 
[*] If the STEAM username is changed it will reflect in game now
[*] Bindings and grip support for Windows MR and HTC Vive Cosmos devices updated
[*] Fixed grip issues with some controls on Index and Vive controllers
[/list]

[h2]Online[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issues with our backend not registering player names correctly (this should fix for anyone hit by this on the next boot up)
[*] We added a version check message which will come up if your client is out of date (and needs to be updated) – NOTE you won’t be able to play online until you update if you see this message
[*] Auto detect for server region improved (this should work consistently when set on Auto now)
[/olist]

[h2]Repair and Practice Robots[/h2]
[list]
[*] Single player and Face To Face robots have managed to order themselves a broader choice of wardrobe
[/list] 

[h2]Face To Face[/h2]
[list]
[*] The web app now warns if your mobile device has too small a screen resolution
[*] Login now shows a timeout message if there are network or server issues
[*] Supernova tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Play in VR and Non-VR
notes.content:
We want Spaceteam VR to be one of the most cross-playable titles on the market and in order to achieve that it will be playable beyond the confines of your VR headset. 

Not only is the game going to be playable online on up to six headsets across all the popular manufacturers, but you’ll be able to play locally with people on their smartphones or tablets as well as multiple VR headsets. Players can take it in turns to experience the VR version while still co-operating and shouting technobabble at each other!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36148352/684ccd277b41ddc8bdfcd05a89e9632244c0a1fe.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Omegathon Final![/b][/h2]
We also wanted to tell you about our incredibly successful trip to the glorious PAX East in Boston where over 500 guests got to grips with the game. This is the first time we’ve shown the game to an American audience and the reception was so great, people are really hyped to see the game as a VR version.

We featured on the main stage in the final of the infamous ‘OMEGATHON’ in front of a large audience and 25.8k viewers on the PAX Twitter account.

We are sad that we're not able to bring the game to SXSW as planned but we have our fingers crossed for EGX Rezzed in a few weeks - watch this space for the latest news! 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/560343416?t=05h12m57s&tt_content=text_link&tt_medium=vod_embed]Watch the PAX EAST 2020 OMEGATHON on their Twitch channel[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36148352/316fb9d808c55abd3b3d87d4468b40a426e600f8.jpg[/img][/url]

tags.feature: Not only is the game going to be playable online on up to six headsets across all the popular manufacturers, but you’ll be able to play locally with people on their smartphones or tablets as well as multiple VR headsets.
